activities.name: Step Start
activities.description: Marks the Raw to Replica step as in-progress by inserting a new run record into STEP_RUN_TBL, updating STEP_STS_CD to in-progress in STEP_CTRL_TBL, and returning STEP_RUN_SK and CYC_RUN_SK for use by downstream activities.

activities.name: PROC_WRAPPER_RPL_RFN
activities.description: Clears and rebuilds TABLES_TO_LOAD_RFN with active Replica→Refined jobs, ready for the ForEach to iterate.

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT TGT_FILE_TBL, SRC_PATH_SCHEM, TGT_PATH_SCHEM, CAST(JOB_SK AS VARCHAR) AS JOB_SK, STEP_SK FROM @{pipeline().parameters.ASQL_SCHEMA}.TABLES_TO_LOAD_RFN WHERE XCENTER='@{pipeline().parameters.XCENTER}'
SELECT CAST(CYC_CUR_RUN_SK AS VARCHAR) AS CYC_CUR_RUN_SK FROM @{pipeline().parameters.ASQL_SCHEMA}.CYC_CTRL_TBL WHERE CYC_SK=@{pipeline().parameters.CYC_SK}

SELECT TOP 1 CYC_RUN_SK AS PREV_REFINED_CYC_RUN_SK FROM abc.CYC_RUN_TBL WHERE CYC_SK = @{pipeline().parameters.CYC_SK} AND CYC_RUN_SK < @{activity('Fetch CUR_CYC_RUN_SK').output.firstRow['CYC_CUR_RUN_SK']} AND CYC_STS_CD = 'S' ORDER BY CYC_RUN_SK DESC

activities.name: Replica To Refined Data Load
activities.description:
Transforms replica Delta tables into refined Delta tables using SCD Type 2. For each refined table (claim_detail or claim_financial), it runs a pre-configured JOIN query (stored in abc.JOB_PARM_TBL) to pull and enrich data from replica, computes hash keys to detect changes, then either creates the table from scratch (initial load) or merges changes in as versioned rows (incremental load) — keeping full history where old versions are expired (ETL_ActiveRow_Flag='N') and new versions inserted. Also propagates soft-deletes and retired records from replica into refined by marking those rows inactive.

Compared to the previous recon/validation notebooks:
  - Notebooks 08/09/10 — stay entirely within the replica layer; read raw parquet and replica tables to verify counts match
  - Notebook 11 — stays within the replica layer; flags bad data rows
  - Notebook 12 — first notebook to write to a new layer (replica → refined); adds SCD2 history tracking and business-level joins that didn't exist in replica
